usageNotes: Use this to set or update the freeform notes text stored in the PDM system configuration — useful for recording maintenance windows, handoff notes, or datacenter context visible to all administrators. Requires the System.Modify privilege on the /system/notes ACL path. Pass the current config digest to guard against concurrent overwrites; omit it only when last-write-wins behavior is acceptable.

examples.summary: Update PDM notes with a maintenance reminder, using digest to prevent overwrite conflicts

params.notes: Scheduled maintenance window: 2026-07-05 02:00–04:00 UTC. All PDM nodes expected to restart. Contact hello@nightsquawk.tech for emergencies.

tips: The endpoint returns null on success — a 200 with no body is the expected success response.
Supplying 'digest' is strongly recommended in multi-admin environments; PDM will reject the write if the config has changed since the digest was read, preventing silent overwrites.
Notes are stored in the PDM configuration file and are visible to any user who can read the config — do not store credentials or secrets here.
To read the current notes (and obtain a fresh digest), use get_config_notes before writing.
